verdict.rationale: Cognee documents some operations that act on many items at once: `.forget` can remove an entire dataset with its graph and vector data, or everything the current user can delete, and the GitHub integration indexes every covered repository in an organization. These are scoped bulk actions, not a general bulk-operations facility. missing for 10: a general batch API or CLI for running arbitrary operations (remember/improve/update) across selected item sets, explicit multi-item batch ingestion docs, bulk edit or update of items, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Dataset deletion: remove an entire dataset and its graph/vector data. Full cleanup: remove everything the current user can delete.
Remove a data item, an entire dataset, or all memory for the current user.
Connect a GitHub organization and index every covered repository into the code graph.
